The absence of a backrest increases its versatility, encouraging free use and allowing rest from any side. This well-thought-out solution perfectly meets the needs of heavily used public spaces, such as bustling city squares, transport hubs with stops, and picturesque park walkways, where the possibility of a quick respite without dictating a specific seating position is important. That's why we offer two construction options for our backless street furniture bench to perfectly match it to the specifics of the project and the investor's expectations: Stainless steel benches: For clients who prioritize the highest quality and timeless elegance, we offer steel benches made of stainless steel. Powder-coated metal benches (RAL): If color and visual consistency play a significant role in your project, our metal benches with a steel structure powder-coated in any color from the rich RAL palette are the ideal solution. This modern technology provides a durable, aesthetic, and weather-resistant coating. Thanks to the wide selection of RAL colors, you can perfectly match the street furniture benches to the surroundings, creating unique and harmonious modern street furniture that attracts attention and emphasizes the character of the place. Comfortable Seat – Natural Warmth of Wood for User Enjoyment: Caring for comfort and aesthetics, the seat of our backless bench is made of selected wooden planks. We offer three types of wood to meet diverse preferences and project needs: Benches with wooden elements (pine): Classic and economical pine wood with a light, natural shade, ideal for park benches and other street furniture, introducing a natural accent and warm atmosphere to the space. Benches with wooden elements (alder): Valued for its warm, honey color and soft texture, alder wood adds coziness to street furniture and perfectly complements the greenery of parks and squares, creating a relaxing atmosphere in the urban space arrangement. Benches with wooden elements (sapeli): Exotic sapeli wood with a rich, mahogany color and elegant grain pattern is a synonym for luxury and durability, ideal for prestigious locations where street furniture elements should emphasize the unique character of the place and add a sophisticated style to it. series.descriptionSource: Backless Street Furniture Benches – Minimalism and Durability in Public Spaces Discover the essence of functionality and modern design with our backless and armrest-free street furniture benches. These minimalist yet exceptionally durable pieces of street furniture perfectly fit into a variety of public spaces, from modern squares to quiet park walkways. When designing our benches, we focused on combining high-quality materials with a simple, elegant form that will stand the test of time and heavy use. The construction of our backless benches is the foundation of their reliability. We offer two frame options: stainless steel, valued for its exceptional resistance to corrosion and elegant, timeless appearance, and black steel, which, thanks to the powder coating process in any RAL palette color, gains not only an aesthetic look but also excellent protection against atmospheric factors. Choosing the right construction material allows the bench to be adapted to the specific environmental conditions and visual preferences. The seat of our backless benches is made of selected wood, which adds warmth and a natural character to the raw elegance of the metal construction. We offer three types of wood: Pine wood: Characterized by a light color and distinct grain. It is a popular choice due to its durability and versatility, perfectly complementing various architectural styles. Alder wood: Has a warmer shade and a uniform texture. It is soft and pleasant to the touch, which increases the comfort of using the bench. Sapeli wood: This exotic wood has a rich, mahogany color and a distinctive grain pattern. Its high hardness and abrasion resistance guarantee the longevity of the seat, adding a luxurious character to the bench. Their universal design makes them perfect as benches for squares, walkway benches, benches in front of buildings, as well as practical bus stop benches. The absence of a backrest and armrests encourages short breaks and free interaction, while not restricting space. As an experienced street furniture manufacturer, we offer solutions that not only fulfill their utility function but also aesthetically enrich public spaces. Street furniture projects with our participation are a guarantee of durability and a modern look. By choosing our backless street furniture benches, you invest in durable and aesthetic public space furnishings that will serve residents and users for many years. We invite you to explore our offer and create a functional and stylish arrangement of urban space. We also offer custom street furniture, which allows our products to be perfectly tailored to individual needs and projects.

Each type of wood is carefully finished to ensure maximum seating comfort and resistance to external factors. The modular construction of the backless octagonal bench is its greatest advantage. Individual segments can be combined in any configuration, creating both smaller, independent seats and larger installations surrounding landscape elements. This flexibility allows for optimal use of available space and adaptation of the furniture to the specific needs of a given place. The backless octagonal modular bench is an ideal solution for parks, squares, plazas, and other public spaces where both functionality and aesthetics are important.
